name: comp-591
title: AI Model Selector Header
blurb: AI model selector header with chat and user menus.
description: Header with AI model dropdown (showing descriptions), chat layout toggle, and user menu. Minimal, focused on model selection.
use_when: LLM/AI chat interfaces where users frequently switch between different model options.
avoid_when: Simple apps; model selector adds cognitive load.
a11y: Model select has aria-label. Descriptions are visible in dropdown. Chat and user buttons labeled.
